WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, p.sku, f.net_amount AS net_sales, f.standard_cost AS cost
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, p.sku, -r.refund_net, -r.standard_cost_returned
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT cp.category AS cur_category, cp.subcategory = 'Outdoor Lighting' AS is_outdoor, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales, SUM(n.net_sales - n.cost) AS gm, count(*) n_rows, count(DISTINCT n.sku) skus
FROM net_lines n
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = n.sku AND cp.is_current
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period = 6 AND cp.category IN ('Garden','Electrical')
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

),

    FROM fact_sales_line f

),
mine AS (SELECT business_date, store_id, SUM(net_sales) ns FROM net_lines WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-09-22' AND DATE '2025-10-26' GROUP BY 1,2),
ctl AS (SELECT business_date, store_id, net_sales ns FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-09-22' AND DATE '2025-10-26')

WITH d AS (
  SELECT receipt_id, line_no FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-09-15' AND DATE '2025-11-02' GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING count(*)>1
)
SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.receipt_id, f.line_no, f.sale_date, f.sale_ts_utc, f.store_key, f.product_key, f.channel_code, f.channel_id, f.quantity, f.net_amount, f.standard_cost, f.etl_loaded_at
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN d USING (receipt_id, line_no) ORDER BY f.receipt_id, f.line_no, f.sales_line_id LIMIT 24

WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT f.*, count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY receipt_id, line_no) c, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY receipt_id, line_no ORDER BY sales_line_id) rn
  FROM fact_sales_line f
)
SELECT min(sale_date) mn, max(sale_date) mx, count(*) dup_rows_extra, count(DISTINCT etl_loaded_at) loads, min(etl_loaded_at) l0, max(etl_loaded_at) l1, min(sales_line_id) id0, max(sales_line_id) id1, sum(net_amount) net_extra, max(c) maxc,
 count(DISTINCT store_key) stores
FROM ranked WHERE c > 1 AND rn > 1

calls.statement:
WITH params AS (
    SELECT 'FY2025/26' AS fiscal_year, 6 AS fiscal_period
),
web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, p.sku,
           f.net_amount AS net_sales, f.standard_cost AS cost
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, p.sku, -r.refund_net, -r.standard_cost_returned
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT CASE WHEN cp.subcategory = 'Outdoor Lighting' THEN 'Electrical' ELSE cp.category END AS category,
       d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period,
       ROUND(SUM(n.net_sales), 2) AS net_sales,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(n.net_sales - n.cost) / SUM(n.net_sales), 1) AS gross_margin_pct
FROM net_lines n
JOIN dim_date d     ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = n.sku AND cp.is_current
JOIN params ON d.fiscal_year = params.fiscal_year AND d.fiscal_period = params.fiscal_period
WHERE CASE WHEN cp.subcategory = 'Outdoor Lighting' THEN 'Electrical' ELSE cp.category END IN ('Garden', 'Electrical')
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
ORDER BY 1
